description: USE WHEN you want to stress a portfolio of SPY, TLT, GOLD and BTC across cross-asset regimes. Provide `holdings` as [{asset, weight}] (weights normalised; GLD accepted for GOLD, BTC-USD for BTC). Returns per regime (baseline / risk_off_crisis / rate_shock): return, worst-episode drawdown, per-leg decomposition and a cross_asset_finding (diversification_intact / hedge_holds / hedge_breaks / shared_drawdown / concentrated_loss), plus sustained drawdowns over the simulated paths. The joint correlation structure, including the bond hedge that can break under rate shocks, comes from a pre-computed substrate, so the call is instant. Optional `costs` ({rebalance: none|daily|monthly|quarterly|band, annual_costs: {asset: fraction}, transaction_cost_bps}) adds a cost_impact block paired on identical paths. Other tickers: build_portfolio (full tier, needs an access token) in assess mode (portfolios={name:{ticker:weight}}). Descriptive, not advisory.

costs.description: Optional cost model: {'rebalance': 'monthly', 'transaction_cost_bps': float, 'annual_costs': {ASSET: annual fraction}}. Omit for the frictionless default.
costs.title: Costs

holdings.description: Portfolio legs: list of {asset, weight} objects, e.g. [{'asset': 'SPY', 'weight': 0.6}, {'asset': 'TLT', 'weight': 0.4}]. Assets: SPY, TLT, GOLD, BTC (aliases GLD, BTC-USD). Weights are non-negative and normalised to sum to 1; at most 50 legs, no duplicates.
holdings.title: Holdings
